data.one_liner: Dio interceptor that caches responses using stash
data.what_it_does: Adds a caching layer to Dio requests by storing responses in a stash cache. Subsequent identical requests are served from the cache instead of hitting the network.
use_when: You need to cache REST API responses to reduce network traffic
You want offline support for previously fetched data
You want to avoid duplicate network calls for the same endpoint
avoid_when: You require custom caching logic not supported by stash
You are not using Dio or prefer another HTTP client
strengths: Supports any stash backend (memory, file, shared_preferences)
Transparent caching – no changes to request code
weaknesses: Depends on the stash package, adding another dependency
No built‑in support for GraphQL or WebSocket caching
Limited control over cache eviction policies
data.setup_notes: Add stash_dio to pubspec, import stash_dio and stash, create a stash store, add cache.interceptor to Dio interceptors

alternatives.name: dio
alternatives.why_pick_it: Base HTTP client; no caching but can be extended with custom interceptors

alternatives.name: http
alternatives.why_pick_it: Simple HTTP client but lacks built‑in caching
